{{Top|leg}}
The '''Chosen of Vahl''' were the central coven of six priests who governed the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] cult. Although individual [[Vahla]] often set off on their own, all members of the nomadic [[Species/Legends|species]] were expected to heed the coven's demands. The priests would consult their [[God/Legends|goddess]] [[Vahl]] using [[Farsight/Legends|farseeing]], interpret omens, and make policies for the Vahla. The priests would show their goddess their faith and devotion by scarring themselves.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
